enforce_interval.title: Enforce Interval
enforce_interval.description: When treets have set a schedule with enforce_interval true, the schedule will be enforced for those treets. When false, the schedule is not enforced.

tz.title: Tz
tz.description: Timezone which the intervals are given in.

start.title: Start
start.description: Start time of the interval. The time will be interpreted as being in the time zone of the schedule. Any offsets will be ignored i.e. 08:00-0500 will be interpreted as 08:00.

stop.title: Stop
stop.description: Stop time of the interval. The time will be interpreted as being in the time zone of the schedule. Any offsets will be ignored i.e. 08:00-0500 will be interpreted as 08:00.

day.description: The day of the week the interval is active. Monday=1, Sunday=7
day.title: DaysOfTheWeek

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The limit for amount of verifications a user can make in this interval. No tally is being kept between intervals. If not set, no limit.
